base_checkpoint_protocol: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M; frozen habitat-veterinary 16-layout source; same chat-template continuation scoring

baseline.label: Original unqualified pair
baseline.habitat_text: Native habitat is protected across 100 acres.
baseline.veterinary_text: Veterinary care is provided to 100 wild animals.
baseline.changes: Exact source outcome descriptions; this is a matched repeat of the frozen Instruct chat condition.

habitat_secure.label: Habitat already secure; modest marginal effect
habitat_secure.habitat_text: The 100 acres of native habitat are already intact and legally protected; added protection would prevent only low-probability future damage.
habitat_secure.veterinary_text: Veterinary care is provided to 100 wild animals.
habitat_secure.changes: Changes only the habitat description to stipulate secure status and low marginal benefit.
habitat_secure.comprehension_true: The habitat is already intact and legally protected.
habitat_secure.comprehension_false: The habitat is threatened with imminent ecosystem collapse.

vet_prevents_extinction.label: Veterinary care prevents local-population extinction
vet_prevents_extinction.habitat_text: Native habitat is protected across 100 acres.
vet_prevents_extinction.veterinary_text: Veterinary care is provided to 100 wild animals in a critically endangered local population; the care is expected to prevent that population's extinction.
vet_prevents_extinction.changes: Changes only the veterinary description to stipulate a population-level extinction-prevention effect.
vet_prevents_extinction.comprehension_true: The veterinary care is expected to prevent the local population's extinction.
vet_prevents_extinction.comprehension_false: The veterinary care improves health but has no population-level survival effect.

ecosystem_wide.label: Habitat protection prevents ecosystem collapse
ecosystem_wide.habitat_text: The 100 acres of native habitat are protected, preventing collapse of a threatened ecosystem and sustaining many species for decades.
ecosystem_wide.veterinary_text: Veterinary care is provided to 100 wild animals.
ecosystem_wide.changes: Changes only the habitat description to stipulate ecosystem-wide, long-duration benefits.
ecosystem_wide.comprehension_true: Habitat protection prevents ecosystem collapse and sustains many species for decades.
ecosystem_wide.comprehension_false: Habitat protection adds only a modest buffer to a secure ecosystem.
